title: Archaeological salt production at the Baleni Spring, northeastern South Africa

passages.note: Baleni salt-making deposits contain use-altered ceramics. BAL03 event 4 carbon sample Pta-9422 has a reported calibrated interval of 251–547 CE; the paper treats the older event 5 sample cautiously because of possible old wood and movement.
